risks.why: Binary ships status_bar_height* = 28dp, a device decision. sweet's device overlay sets 100px (36.36dp) and has a 93px punch-hole cutout; the static RRO wins and shortens the bar below the cutout (F source; E consequence).
risks.fix: Delete the three height entries from the portable overlay or split them into a per-device overlay; keep status_bar_system_icon_size and the SystemUI paddings common.

risks.why: Hooks hard-code AOSP class/method names (SettingsBaseActivity/SettingsHomepageActivity; six SystemUI keyguard classes). A ROM rebase can move them; every hook is guarded, so the failure mode is a silently missing header/clock (F class list; ? target dex).
risks.fix: Dex-dump the target APKs and verify every class and method before enabling the LSPosed scope (docs/19 section 5.4).

risks.why: Settings/SettingsLib is the least stable resource surface: settingslib_entry_bg_radius is Lineage-only, four primary_material_* names are framework resources not in the Settings package, and three type styles plus cardview_default_radius come from AARs. Missing names are silently dropped by idmap2 (F source checks; ? target APK).
risks.fix: Run check-target-resources.py against the pulled Settings.apk; delete or re-point entries that are absent; re-run after every ROM or AndroidX bump.

rows.what_breaks: HOME role and notification-listener access are per-ROM user grants; live tiles stay static until the listener is allowed. The first-fit grid recomputes from the real width, but the design reference is 360-411dp, so a >=600dp window gets a different (not broken) layout. No target resource names, no ROM APIs.
rows.check: aapt2 dump badging evidence/launcher-v3/ztmetro-start.apk | grep -E 'package:|launchable-activity:'; adb shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME; adb shell cmd notification allow_listener org.ztmetro.start/.StartNotificationListener

rows.what_breaks: Torch needs CAMERA permission plus a flash unit (optional feature in the manifest); brightness/rotation need the WRITE_SETTINGS appop; the notification listener must be enabled by the user. A ROM with a different torch HAL or no flash makes only the torch tile inert.
rows.check: adb shell dumpsys package org.ztmetro.actioncentre | grep -E 'versionName|android.permission.CAMERA'; adb shell appops get org.ztmetro.actioncentre WRITE_SETTINGS; adb shell cmd notification allow_listener org.ztmetro.actioncentre/org.ztmetro.actioncentre.ActionCentreListener; adb shell am start -n org.ztmetro.actioncentre/.ActionCentreActivity

rows.artifact: Design tokens and generated Android resources
rows.what_breaks: Values are dp/sp (density-independent), but README pins the reference at 720x1280 @ 320dpi = 360x640dp; ugglite runs 280dpi = 411x731dp and sweet 440dpi = 393x873dp. The launcher recomputes its grid from width, so the look survives; any layout that hardcodes the 360dp reference will not.
rows.check: adb shell wm size; adb shell wm density; python3 design/tokens/gen_android.py --out /tmp/ztmetro-tokens; diff -u evidence/launcher-v3/metro_tokens.generated.xml /tmp/ztmetro-tokens/res/values/metro_tokens.xml

rows.what_breaks: Needs SDK platform 36 + build-tools 36.0.0 + JDK 17; when the SDK is absent the scripts drive ssh hermes-ubuntu. build-overlay-module.sh requires the three evidence APKs to exist first, so a stale APK becomes a stale zip.
rows.check: bash -n scripts/*.sh; ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/android-sdk" JAVA_HOME="$HOME/android-jdk" bash scripts/build-overlay-framework.sh --out /tmp/fw-check

rows.artifact: framework-res RRO (ZtMetroFramework.apk, target android, isStatic=true, priority 2)
rows.what_breaks: 92 AOSP-16 names (accent_*, system_accent1/2/3_*, TextAppearance.Material.*, config_*CornerRadius, dialog_corner_radius, action_bar_default_height_material). They are AOSP-stable at API 36; an Android 15 base lacks the M3 names and a ROM's own static android overlay can out-rank priority 2. isStatic=true means it cannot be toggled at runtime.
rows.check: python3 evidence/portability/check-target-resources.py --overlay-dir overlay/framework --target-apk /tmp/target/framework-res.apk; adb shell su -c 'cmd overlay list | grep ztmetro'; adb shell su -c 'cmd overlay dump org.ztmetro.overlay.framework'

rows.what_breaks: 25 names tied to the 2025 shade: qs_*, notification_corner_radius*, shade_header_text_color, TextAppearance.QS.Status*, shade_panel_fallback. All 25 exist in AOSP 16 and Lineage 23.2; lineage-22.2 has no shade_header_text_color anywhere in SystemUI res, and older bases use a different shade. overlay_shade_panel_shape_radius is inert at 23.2 (0 consumers) and proves nothing. On a blur-capable device the *_fallback colors are not used.
rows.check: python3 evidence/portability/check-target-resources.py --overlay-dir overlay/systemui --target-apk /tmp/target/SystemUI.apk; aapt2 dump resources /tmp/target/SystemUI.apk | grep -E 'resource .* (style/TextAppearance.QS.Status|dimen/qs_corner_radius|color/shade_header_text_color)'

rows.what_breaks: 93 source names: AOSP Settings names (homepage_*, TextAppearance.*, wifi_item*, radii, SearchBarStyle_v2) plus SettingsLib names and three Material-Components styles. A ROM that rewrites its dashboard (crDroid/PE) can drop homepage_*; pre-16 SettingsLib lacks the expressive radii. The checked-in aapt2 dump is stale (56 entries, 11:22) while the APK was rebuilt at 12:13 (21,196 B); refresh the dump before comparing.
rows.check: python3 evidence/portability/check-target-resources.py --overlay-dir overlay/settings --target-apk /tmp/target/Settings.apk; aapt2 dump resources /tmp/target/Settings.apk | grep -cE 'resource .* (color/homepage_|dimen/min_tap_target_size|style/TextAppearance.SuggestionTitle)'

rows.artifact: Status-strip framework RRO (target android, isStatic=true, priority 20)
rows.what_breaks: Ships status_bar_height / _portrait / _default = 28dp. That is a device decision: sweet's device overlay sets 100px (36.36dp) and has a 93px punch-hole cutout; this static RRO wins and shortens the bar below the cutout (F source; E visual). status_bar_system_icon_size 13dp is portable.
rows.check: adb shell dumpsys window | grep -iE 'status.?bar|cutout'; adb shell wm density; grep -n 'status_bar_height' /src/device/*/overlay/frameworks/base/core/res/res/values/dimens.xml; compare with overlay/status/framework/res/values/dimens.xml

rows.what_breaks: Six entries: status_bar_padding_start/top, icon drawing size/alpha, TextAppearance.StatusBar.Default, system_bar_background_opaque. Padding is device-tuned (8dp on ugglite; sweet's device overlay itself uses 10dp/5dp and would be overridden). Clock position is a LineageSettings runtime value, not a resource.
rows.check: python3 evidence/portability/check-target-resources.py --overlay-dir overlay/status/systemui --target-apk /tmp/target/SystemUI.apk; adb shell su -c 'cmd overlay dump org.ztos.overlay.status.systemui'; screenshot status bar

rows.artifact: Magisk overlays module (preinstalled RRO APKs + boot-time enable)
rows.what_breaks: Requires Magisk (magic mount + root cmd overlay), the /system/product/overlay scan path, and a device-specific boot-image patch. A Lineage user build does not grant CHANGE_OVERLAY_PACKAGES to shell; service.sh enables the runtime overlays as uid 0 at late_start. A ROM without Magisk needs adb root + push or a ROM build.
rows.check: adb shell su -c 'magisk -v'; adb shell su -c 'cmd overlay list | grep -E "ztos|ztmetro"'; adb shell su -c 'cat /data/local/tmp/ztmetro-overlays.log'

rows.artifact: Font Magisk module (Open Sans as sans-serif)
rows.what_breaks: Installer rewrites the live sans-serif family in system/etc/font_fallback.xml (Android 15+ primary) and system/etc/fonts.xml (legacy). A different file layout, a vendor fonts_customization.xml, or a changed family set makes it abort by design (exit 3-7) rather than half-apply. Highest OTA/update risk in the stack.
rows.check: adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk; adb shell su -c 'head -20 /system/etc/font_fallback.xml'; adb shell su -c 'test -f /product/etc/fonts_customization.xml && cat /product/etc/fonts_customization.xml'; bash scripts/build-font-module.sh

rows.what_breaks: Depends on LSPosed/Vector + Zygisk and four Settings methods: SettingsBaseActivity.setContentView(int), .setTitle(CharSequence), .onResume(), SettingsHomepageActivity.onCreate(Bundle). Renamed/removed classes make the guarded hook log an error and leave Settings untouched; the header is gone.
rows.check: unzip -o /tmp/target/Settings.apk 'classes*.dex' -d /tmp/target/settings-dex; for d in /tmp/target/settings-dex/classes*.dex; do $ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/36.0.0/dexdump -d "$d"; done > /tmp/target/settings.dexdump; grep -n 'Lcom/android/settings/core/SettingsBaseActivity;' /tmp/target/settings.dexdump; grep -n -A2 "name *: 'setContentView'" /tmp/target/settings.dexdump; adb logcat -s ztmetro-header

rows.what_breaks: Six SystemUI classes, seven methods: NotificationShadeWindowView#onAttachedToWindow, KeyguardRootView (anchor), KeyguardClockViewBinder#bind, KeyguardIndicationTextView#setNextIndication, com.android.keyguard.KeyguardSliceView#showSlice, AnimatableClockView#refreshTime/onMeasure/setColors. Compose keyguard refactors move these; a missing class is guarded and logged, not fatal.
rows.check: unzip -o /tmp/target/SystemUI.apk 'classes*.dex' -d /tmp/target/sysui-dex; for d in /tmp/target/sysui-dex/classes*.dex; do $ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/36.0.0/dexdump -d "$d"; done > /tmp/target/sysui.dexdump; grep -E 'KeyguardClockViewBinder|NotificationShadeWindowView|KeyguardRootView|KeyguardIndicationTextView|KeyguardSliceView|AnimatableClockView' /tmp/target/sysui.dexdump; adb logcat -s ztmetro-keyguard

rows.artifact: Target/source resource-name checkers and expected lists
rows.what_breaks: The TSVs are a snapshot of the overlay source and go stale as soon as an overlay is edited. Regenerate them with --write-expected before comparing; never trust a TSV older than the APK it is checked against.

rows.artifact: Built evidence APKs (framework, SystemUI, Settings, status, launcher, Action Centre)
rows.what_breaks: Build outputs, not sources. The checked-in Settings aapt2 dump predates the 12:13 rebuild (56 entries vs 93 in source), so a dump-based check can report false missing entries. Refresh the dump from the rebuilt APK before comparing; never port an evidence APK whose entry count differs from its source.
rows.check: aapt2 dump resources evidence/settings-rro/ztmetro-settings-rro.apk > /tmp/settings-current.txt; python3 evidence/portability/check-target-resources.py --overlay-dir overlay/settings --target-dump /tmp/settings-current.txt; sha256sum evidence/settings-rro/ztmetro-settings-rro.apk

rows.artifact: Release zips (overlays, font 1.0.0 Selawik, font 1.1.0 Open Sans)
rows.what_breaks: Zips embed the APKs of the moment they were built; build-overlay-module.sh copies from evidence/, so a stale evidence APK becomes a stale zip. font-1.0.0 is Selawik (no Cyrillic) and must not ship on a Russian UI.

rows.artifact: Magisk/Zygisk/LSPosed (Vector) injection stack and boot patching
rows.what_breaks: Magisk boot-image patching is per device and per ROM build; Zygisk and LSPosed/Vector versions are Android-16 specific; an OTA replaces the boot image and removes root. The overlays module survives a Magisk update but not a ROM reflash.
rows.check: adb shell su -c 'magisk -v'; adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release; adb shell su -c 'ls /data/adb/modules'; after OTA re-check cmd overlay list
